notes: HUNT H3 pair 1 (heat 2484, pt_layers: enemy EoT DCP x dies-census fold). Garruk, Unleashed (seat 0) +1 on ENEMY Conclave Mentor: 'Up to one target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn' (CR 601.2b target has no controller restriction; H2 cross-seat precedent). Mentor blocks the 7/7: effective 5/6 (2+3 / 3+3, CR 613.3d layer-7c DCP) -> takes 7 and DIES mid-combat; its dies trigger resolves while the EoT buff is still applied (CR 603.3 / 611.2a duration), so 'you gain life equal to its power' pays the EFFECTIVE 5, not the printed 2 -> seat 1 life 25. The +3/+3 also folds into damage assignment: Brute's mark ledger reads 5 (H2 rig law 4, counter/DCP-blind damage would mark 2). Marks on the dying Mentor reset with it (H2 rig law 3) so only Brute's lane is asserted. Falsifiers: no buff at death -> life 22; buff not folded into block damage -> Brute marked 2. Loyalty 5->6 (+1 paid).
